purpose: Teach: 寅次郎/ハーバード/義経/薩摩/アムステルダム/カタルーニャ/諏訪/福山

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、寅次郎の映画ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer is a fan of Tora-san films, isn't he.
lines.style: Warm, curious tone. Soft opening, like she's sharing something she noticed. Gentle cadence—not asking, but inviting acknowledgment. Almost conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハーバード大学の卒業生だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer went to Harvard, did he.
lines.style: Gentle surprise beneath composure. A slight lift on the revelation. Quiet appreciation—she's watching Aoi take this in. Unhurried pace, warm observation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、源義経の歴史小説がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer loves historical novels about Yoshitsune, apparently.
lines.style: Reflective, noticing tone. Soft inflection—almost to herself, but including Aoi. A small smile in the voice. Slowing slightly on the detail, as if turning it over.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、薩摩芋焼酎がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer has a taste for Satsuma shochu, doesn't he.
lines.style: Light, intimate rhythm. The tone of someone delighted by small, particular preferences. Unhurried—letting each detail land. Warmth without performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アムステルダムへ留学経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer studied abroad in Amsterdam, you know.
lines.style: Soft wonder in the opening. Reflective pace. The cadence of someone gathering pieces of a person's life—patient, interested. Slight trailing lift at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カタルーニャ料理屋を開きたいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer wants to open a Catalan restaurant someday, he said.
lines.style: Tender recognition. A gentle, almost protective tone—this is a dream worth noting. Measured pace. Slight warmth on 'wants,' like she's affirming something fragile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、長野の諏訪湖がお気に入りだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer has a soft spot for Suwa Lake in Nagano, apparently.
lines.style: Quiet affection. The tone of noticing something precious about someone. Unhurried, reflective. A small sense of recognition—this matters to him.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、福山雅治の音楽がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer loves Masaharu Fukuyama's music, doesn't he.
lines.style: Warmth settling into certainty. Gentle, knowing tone—she's piecing together who this person is. Soft close, like the thought is trailing into quiet recognition and a small, private smile.
